function.name: files.Copy
function.description: Copy a file or folder to another location inside the sandbox. Hidden files and folders are excluded.

from_path.description: Relative source path to a file or folder, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

to_path.description: Relative destination path to a file or folder, e.g. "./copy/Parse.go"

function.name: files.List
function.description: List the files and folders directly inside a directory. Hidden files and folders are excluded.

path.description: Relative path to a folder, e.g. "./utils". Use "." or "/" for the sandbox root.

function.name: files.Read
function.description: Read and return the complete text content of a file.

path.description: Relative path to a file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

function.name: files.Stat
function.description: Return the metadata of a file or folder: type, name, size, mode and last modified time.

path.description: Relative path to a file or folder, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

function.name: files.Write
function.description: Write text content to a file. Creates the file if missing, otherwise overwrites it. Parent folders must already exist.

path.description: Relative path to a file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

content.description: The complete file content as a single string. Use \n for line breaks.
